description: Make the repository installable, buildable without secrets, and checkable by CI: pin the public npm registry, resync the lockfile so npm ci works, resolve DATABASE_URL lazily, and add typecheck, verify, and a CI workflow.
Add the glob-discovered eval runner over src/eval/**/*.eval.ts, extract batch formatting and pagination windowing into pure modules, and lock both with hermetic evals.
Add AGENTS.md, the always-on rule set under .agents/rules, and a manifest eval that fails when a rule is unindexed or a documented link does not resolve.

Add the durable harness state the planner reads and writes: vision, category weights, feature list, progress log, config, horizon, and the context refresh script, with a schema eval enforcing the feature list invariants.
Add the planner, executor, and validator prompt personas plus a contract eval asserting each prompt still emits the artifact schema the orchestration layer parses.
Add the merge watcher, worktree continuation, provider adapters, and pre-push guards that turn a merge to main into a reviewed draft pull request.
verify: npm run lint:shell && npm run watch:dry-run

description: Add a zero-dependency reporter over the run event stream so a continuation can be inspected after the fact by run, by feature, or as a summary.
Add dependency audit, secret scanning, and code scanning workflows, the manual continuation fallback, the autonomy model document, and a branch ruleset staged for later application.
Seed the product roadmap from the vision into this file, set the opening horizon slice, and take the harness through its first supervised live run.
